payload.reason: The evidence indicates that pre-trained embeddings significantly enhance the performance of NLP models, particularly in sequence tagging tasks. Without access to these embeddings, the performance would likely decrease, as shown by experiments that removed task-specific RNNs, leading to lower F1 scores.

claims.text: Not having access to pre-trained embeddings would likely result in lower performance in NLP tasks, as they provide essential context-sensitive representations.
Experiments show that models relying solely on LM embeddings without task-specific RNNs perform significantly worse, indicating the importance of pre-trained embeddings.
Including pre-trained embeddings has been shown to improve performance metrics, such as F1 scores, in sequence tagging tasks.
